title.en: An Act Appropriating a Certain Sum, Out of the Funds in the Insular Treasury Not Otherwise Appropriated, for the Maintenance of the New Southern Islands

text.en:
The sum of fifty-six thousand and thirty-four pesos and fifty centavos is hereby appropriated, out
of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the maintenance of the new Southern
Islands Hospital.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, February 11, 1913.
